# RepoGraph

| Axis | Norm | Origin |
|---|---|---|
| Build | Python dependencies pinned in `requirements.txt` | `requirements.txt` |

## Rationale

`RepoGraph` has the thinnest surface of any carded repository: a single `requirements.txt` and nothing else that constrains work. No package metadata, no tests, no CI, no agent-context document.

Its one row is the dependency list. That is the entire repository's declared contract, and it is honest to say so rather than pad the card.
